question: Which of the following players was named the Men's Player of the Year at the All India Football Federation (AIFF) Awards in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhasish Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Subhasish Bose was named the **Men's Player of the Year** at the **All India Football Federation (AIFF) Awards** held in **May 2025**.
 
• This recognition is considered a prestigious accolade in Indian football, highlighting excellence in performance over the past season.
 
• Subhasish Bose is a defender who has consistently shown strong performances both for his **club** and the **national team**, making him a standout player in Indian football.
 
• His contributions to the game include his defensive skills, leadership on the field, and ability to inspire his teammates during crucial matches.
 
• The selection process for the award involves evaluating players' performances in domestic and international fixtures, and Subhasish Bose emerged as the top performer.
